promptFormat: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished equipment icon: {name}. {subject} Rich hand-painted DiceBound fantasy RPG equipment base art, sculptural volumes, crisp edges, tactile materials, readable silhouette at small inventory size. Square composition, entire item centered with generous transparent margin. Genuinely transparent alpha background. Warm highlights and cool shadows. No text, labels, UI border, scenery, ground plane, watermark or extra panels.
